transcript.answer: The footer is composed by `prFooter()` in `libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts`. It emits the standard `Lore-Task: <uuid>` line, with an optional `Refs #N` line, and every Lore-authored PR uses it. Per specs/6-dark-factory/tasks.md (T047), the footer composer was originally at `agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts`. CLAUDE.md now puts it in the shared lib. Floor stations such as the onboard `open-pr` station (`apps/stations/src/onboard/open-pr/`) attach the footer to the PR bodies they open.
